card.name: Comparison words after no, such as later or less
card.fires_on: The word right after "no" in "no later than" and "no less than", plus a few other words that come before a comparison or limit. It shows up in dosing, timing and preparation instructions.

modes.label: No later/less than
modes.description: Comparative word after "No" that sets a time or amount limit.
modes.example: Perform MR imaging no<< later>> than 60 minutes following EOV

modes.label: Partway through adverb or verb forms
modes.description: Ending of a word like Delayed or Periodically at the start of a phrase.
modes.example: The most frequently administered dose in the 2 flexible-dose clinical trials was 20 mg/day. Period<<ically>> reassess to determine the need for continued

modes.label: Other comparison words
modes.description: Words such as zero, larger or exception inside a comparison or exclusion.
